name: @vrmxg/game-ui
description: VRMXG game UI (M5 W3): the player-facing overlays over the canvas, as DOM with accessible names: the HUD (goal, score, counters, timers, what the player carries, the prompt for what is in reach), dialogue boxes, choices and captions, and the settings controls (volume per bus, rebinding). A choice reaches the simulation only as a recorded input. What each overlay shows is plain functions, tested in Node; the Vue components are compiled and rendered on the server in the tests.
